decision.justification: Two independent views of this merchant disagree with its declaration. The storefront presents a different business, and the telemetry channel agrees. Neither could have produced the other: a merchant cannot change its payment behaviour without changing its actual business, and cannot change its interface without changing what customers see.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100066 declared travel_agency at onboarding 700 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the travel_agency baseline are velocity_recent at +3.2 sigma (observed 2.07 against a category baseline of 1.62), round_share_recent at +2.9 sigma (observed 0.447 against a category baseline of 0.104), chargeback_drift at -2.8 sigma (observed -0.0135 against a category baseline of 0). The checkout surface presents a unlicensed_lending interface at 0.97 confidence, against a declared category of travel_agency. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. Asked directly, the merchant restated its declared business. In total 3 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
